coordination.target: sole product metadata and coordination store
PostgreSQL atomic windows and metadata ledgers
coordination.temporaryBoundary: Existing retained limit enforcement may use the compatibility adapter until PR-04. New Core features must not add Redis use.

coordination.target: No product vector extension or vector store
No generic product queue. A Firecrawl-owned queue may be introduced only inside the isolated PR-08 slice.
No generic product worker. A Firecrawl-owned worker may be introduced only inside the isolated PR-08 slice.
A bounded one-shot retention command invoked by the appliance supervisor and guarded by a PostgreSQL advisory lock. No generic scheduler is retained.

A metadata-only PostgreSQL ledger unique on Keycloak subject ID, operation code, and idempotency key. It stores bounded fingerprints, state, outcome, resource ID, correlation ID, status, and expiry, never request or response bodies or secrets.
A PostgreSQL atomic minute window per Application ID. Limits remain optional and disabled by default. An enabled limit fails closed if PostgreSQL is unavailable.
PostgreSQL daily metadata-only Application usage buckets retained for 90 days.
